## StoredMove type

A move played into the tree, as opposed to a candidate out of generateMoves. san can't be required on HexMove itself: moveToSan derives it from the candidate list, so requiring it on candidates would be circular.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type StoredMove = HexMove & {
    san: string;
};
```
**References:** [HexMove](./chess.ts.hexmove.md)
